title: Airtight
text: Airtight. There are just 2 of us, and our cookies, crackers, candy, and raisins get stale before we can use them all.  I bought 3 sets, and they fit nicely on a wide countertop, and look great, and keep food fresh.

product_metadata.title: Le'raze Food Storage Containers with Airtight Lids - Retro Design - Pantry Organization, Glass Canisters Storage for Cookies, Tea, Sugar, Candy Jars, Sugar Packet, Set of 3
features: ORGANIZING JARS: Line up our glass canisters on your kitchen counter to store dry ingredients such as pasta, cereal, oatmeal, beans, rice, nuts, etc. They are the Best for coffee and tea lovers to store your coffee beans, ground coffee, loose or bag teas, sugar, snacks, or cookies. They are perfect for decorating and storing food in your pantry and kitchen, LE'RAZE products are practical, functional, and stylish for storage and display at home.

MULTIPURPOSE USE: With our dry food storage containers, you can store large amounts of food in just a few jars, highly saving space in your kitchen pantry. Actually, these jars not only can be used in pantry organization and storage but can also be used in restaurants, coffee bars, etc.

SIMPLE TO CLEAN: These canisters are easy and simple to clean by hand or just put them in the dishwasher for your convenience. The glass does not discolor, retain any smells or leach chemicals into food. With these glass jars, you can keep your kitchen clean and tidy.

WHY CHOOSE A GLASS OVER PLASTIC? It looks sleek and elegant, and is thicker and sturdier than plastic. Glass is also better for the planet. Made from all-natural, sustainable raw materials, glass is 100% recyclable, lead and BPA free, and can be reused endlessly.

MAKES A GREAT GIFT: Let's face it! - Everyone can use more storage. Our glass storage canisters are the perfect choice for weddings, housewarming, bridal showers, birthdays, Christmas, graduations, and more.
Set includes one of each: 54oz (4.75"D x 8"H), 43oz (4.5"D x 7.5"H), 34oz (4.25"D x 7"H).
